bucket.title: Publish from Bucket
bucket.tip: Upload the installer to the patch bucket first, then pick the object here: the server reads it to compute the SHA-256, parses the version from the file name, and builds the Direct mirror URL.
bucket.prefixPlaceholder: e.g. patch/, empty to list everything
bucket.objectPlaceholder: Select an object in the bucket
bucket.objectEmpty: No objects under this prefix, or the bucket is not configured
bucket.versionAutoHint: Empty to parse from the object file name, e.g. Snap.Hutao.1.17.2.0.msix
bucket.mirrorNameHint: Empty to use the bucket host name
bucket.validationHint: Paste a precomputed checksum to skip downloading the installer: the server only HEADs the object. Leave empty to hash the object.
bucket.validationPlaceholder: 64 hex characters; empty to let the server compute it
bucket.publishing: Reading the object and computing the SHA-256; a large installer takes a while…
bucket.truncated: More than 200 objects; only the first 200 are shown, narrow the prefix
bucket.objectRequired: Select the installer object to publish first
bucket.publishFail: Failed to publish from the bucket
bucket.listFail: Failed to load the bucket objects
